text_block_list.text:
One day, as summer camp reached the halfway mark,
I happened upon Mejiro Ardan chatting
with someone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey, Ardan-san's Trainer!
Hello there~.

She is Mejiro Palmer. A cheerful and vivacious
runaway frontrunner, she often chats with
Mejiro Ardan through their Mejiro family connection.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I know! Why don't you just ask your trainer about what you were talking about earlier?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Indeed...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, we were talking about visiting a beach hut
tomorrow with everyone from the Mejiro family,
since our days off lined up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san mentioned she hadn't really
been to a beach hut before, so I thought we could
all go together since we're here, but――"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I was just informed by the camp staff
that a supervisor is required
whenever a large group goes out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If it's alright with you, Trainer,
would you mind coming along?
As our adult chaperone, so to speak.
choice_data_list: If that's the case, it's no trouble at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Well then, I look forward to working with you tomorrow.

Arriving at a nearby beach hut
with Mejiro Ardan and the others—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! This beach hut has such a charming atmosphere—it's quite exciting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that sounds just like you, Ardan-san.
For now, wanna sit down and grab a bite?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, shall we?
What about everyone else—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! What a wonderfully extensive
shaved ice lineup.
You can truly feel the shopkeeper's passion—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Strawberry milk, Uji matcha,
mango, ramune... They have the staples, plus a few unique ones too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Which one will you have, McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Well, with so many options,
I find myself at a loss... What will you do, Ryan?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take this one!
Chocolate shaved ice with protein!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, quite the typical choice for Ryan—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~! Do look at this, Dober.
This "Memorial Juice"! It's drawn
such an adorable heart with the straw~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"How curious that there are two spouts, though.
I wonder how one is meant to drink from it~?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I kind of thought... this wouldn't have anything
to do with us, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my? Do you know about it, Dober~?
Do tell me all about it, please~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Um, ah.
This is, well... how should I put it, something two people who are really close... drink together...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Then it's perfect for the two of us~.
After all, we're two peas in a pod~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not what I meant!
Ugh, jeez—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Feels like everyone's just being their usual selves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "It seems everyone is enjoying themselves, which is wonderful to see. Shall we follow their example?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Still... Looking at it like this,
beach huts really do have
such a wide variety of menus, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, there are more mature and stylish beach huts,
but this place is lively and has that quintessential, classic vibe, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's time to eat, I can't decide what to choose.
I feel just like an explorer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how about that over there?
It says "Super Spicy VS Super Numbing Fair"!
Looks exciting and fun~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Summer-limited, you say...
There's a wonderful, once-in-a-lifetime charm to that.
Shall we go with this one?

The special fair menu Mejiro Ardan and Mejiro Palmer
were looking at was filled with nothing but fiery red dishes...!
choice_data_list: You look like you're in a lot of pain, are you okay?
You seem to be having a really tough time, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even that is part of a once-in-a-lifetime encounter.
Rest assured, I am quite confident
in my ability to finish whatever is served to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I've decided what I'm ordering,
what about you, Ardan-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's see...
I've managed to narrow it down to two, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Since you're here,
I'll let you decide, Trainer.
Could you choose between these two?"

The menu that Mejiro Ardan
pointed to was—
choice_data_list: "Put your back into it: Devilishly Spicy Extra-Meat Mapo Tofu"
"Pump up your Guts. Super Numbing Brothless Dan Dan Noodles"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll have one...
"Power Up: Extra-Spicy Double-Meat Mapo Tofu"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*pfft*, haha!
Reading out the menu name so earnestly is unfair, Ardan-san...!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting!
Here is the "Demon-Spicy Extra-Meat Mapo Tofu"!

What was served to Mejiro Ardan was a scorching,
lava-like dish that made you sweat just looking at it!
However, she—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My...!
What an enticing color and aroma.
Well then, let us eat.

Even with a slight sweat, she kept eating
at a steady pace without batting an eye...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaa! That was so, so spicy!
At least it was the delicious kind of spicy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The first bite took me by surprise,
but amidst the spiciness was a distinct, rich umami.
It was quite delicious.
choice_data_list: So you're good with spicy food, huh.
So you're good with spicy food, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if I'd call it a strong suit...
but when it comes to physical stimulation, I'm fairly confident in my endurance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Could this also be because... I had many opportunities to ingest bitter things when I was young?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"You know, if Ardan-san were in an endurance contest,
I bet she'd be super strong~.
None of the Mejiros could probably beat her!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
An endurance contest...!
If the opportunity arises, I'd certainly love to try it...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"When that time comes,
why don't you join us again, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: I need to keep an eye on Aldan to make sure she doesn't push herself too hard.
I should keep an eye on Aldan so she doesn't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh my...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haha! That's the image people have of Ardan-san? That's hilarious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's troubling because I know exactly what you mean.
Now Trainer definitely has to come see it, no matter what.
And so, chatting about trivial things, another summer memory with Mejiro Ardan was made...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll have one...
"Guts Up: Super-Numbing Soupless Dandan Noodles"—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*pfft*, haha!
Reading out the menu name so earnestly is unfair, Ardan-san...!

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting!
Here is the "Demon-Numb Soupless Dandan Noodles"!

What was served to Mejiro Ardan was a searing dish
so rich in spice that just smelling it made you sweat!
However, she—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My...!
What an appetizing and enticing aroma.
Well then, let us eat.

Even with a slight sweat, she kept eating
at a steady pace without batting an eye...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaa! That was super numbingly spicy!
At least it was the delicious kind of spicy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The first bite took me by surprise,
but concentrated within that sharp numbing sensation was pure flavor.
It was truly delectable.
choice_data_list: So you're good with spicy food, huh.
So you're good with spicy food, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if I'd call it a strong suit...
but when it comes to physical stimulation, I'm fairly confident in my endurance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Could this also be because... I had many opportunities to ingest bitter things when I was young?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Y'know, I was thinking, Ardan-san's got some real guts! Like, she's not scared of new things at all. She's totally got that 'let's just give it a shot' spirit, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Is that so?
I've never really thought about it myself, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps it's because deep down, I always feel that if I don't do it 'now,' I might end up regretting it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Then we have to enjoy the beach hut to the fullest today so we don't have any regrets!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's quite true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san! Palmer!
Do you two want some ice cream? Apparently, you can choose your own fruit toppings!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Heh~, nice, that sounds like fun!
Ardan-san, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Let's go, Trainer.

While enjoying the beach house after that,
I made yet another summer memory
with Mejiro Ardan...
